query:
SELECT ia.id as "id!: Uuid",
                      ia.issue_id as "issue_id!: Uuid",
                      ia.user_id as "user_id!: Uuid",
                      ia.assigned_at as "assigned_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
               FROM issue_assignees ia
               JOIN issues i ON i.id = ia.issue_id
               WHERE i.project_id = $1
